title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Tariff Rule: Weekly Pricing of Self-Pay Days
content:
**Tariff rule.** The self-pay charge on a Rental Vehicle Coordination insurance rental prices the self-pay days by their count: seven or more self-pay days are charged the adjusted weekly rate for each full seven-day block plus the remaining self-pay days at the self-pay day rate, those remaining days never costing more than one adjusted weekly rate; at least the weekly-rate threshold of 5 (the same 5 days in every class) but fewer than seven self-pay days are charged the lesser of those days at the self-pay day rate and one adjusted weekly rate; fewer self-pay days are charged at the self-pay day rate.

The adjusted weekly rate is the class weekly rate multiplied by the self-pay day rate and divided by the class partner daily rate. Rental days, from which the self-pay days are taken, are the whole days between the pickup date and the return date, plus one where the return time as counted is later than the pickup time of day.

## Pricing bands

| Self-pay days | Priced at |
|---|---|
| 1 to 4 | The days at the self-pay day rate |
| 5 or 6 | The lesser of the days at the self-pay day rate and one adjusted weekly rate |
| 7 or more | One adjusted weekly rate per full seven-day block, plus the remaining days at the self-pay day rate, the remaining days held at one adjusted weekly rate |

## Worked figures (hypothetical Full-Size Rental: weekly rate 299.00 USD, partner daily rate 52.99 USD, self-pay day rate 52.99 USD, so an adjusted weekly rate of 299.00 USD)

- 4 self-pay days: 211.96 USD.
- 5 self-pay days: the lesser of 264.95 and 299.00 USD, 264.95 USD. 6 days: the lesser of 317.94 and 299.00 USD, 299.00 USD.
- 9 self-pay days: 299.00 USD for the block plus 2 days at 52.99 USD, 105.98 USD, together 404.98 USD.
- With a self-pay day rate of 45.0415 USD on the same class, the adjusted weekly rate is 299.00 multiplied by 45.0415 and divided by 52.99, 254.15 USD.
